title: Video Jigsaw
description: Assemble live moving-video puzzle tiles while the clip plays in real time—track motion across seams and lock every animated piece into one seamless cinema frame.
controls: Drag animated video puzzle pieces onto matching slots by following the live moving footage until the full video plays seamlessly.

zh-CN.title: 动态视频拼图
zh-CN.description: 会动的创意视频拼图！每一块拼图都在实时播放动态画面，顺着画面运动轨迹把碎片拼成一段完整流畅的动态影片。
zh-CN.controls: 观察碎片中的动态画面走向，拖动拼图块到对应位置吸附拼接，还原完整播放的视频即可过关。
